prompt: A nomad camp of tents that packs up and moves with the seasons.

card.name: Seasonal Nomad Camp

site.text: An open, level clearing of grass or plains where tents can be pitched in a loose ring around a central fire, with room to be struck and moved.

style.text: Portable and weathered: wool and hide tents on wooden poles, rope, hay bales, banners, lanterns and campfires; warm earthy colours.

purpose.text: A nomad camp that packs up and moves with the seasons, a mobile home base for a travelling people and their herds.

card.interpretation: I read this as a medium, low-density camp of tents on flat open ground, in a rustic, portable style, working as a mobile home base. Buildings are light tents, wagons and a corral, so it looks like it could be packed up. No backstory was given, so none is added.

contradictions.issue: A camp that moves can't be permanently built in a world.
contradictions.resolution: Built as one season's encampment, with wagons, bundled goods and bare fire pits suggesting it can be struck and moved.

assumptions: Size M with low density, since tents are sparse.
Rustic style chosen as the nearest template.
Home base chosen as the purpose template.

program.notes: Largest tent beside the central fire; banners, rugs, map table showing seasonal routes.
Wool tents with beds, chests and rugs; each a different colour.
Ring of logs for seating around a campfire.
Fenced pen for horses, sheep or camels with hay.
Covered wagons loaded with crates and barrels, ready to roll.
Smoking racks, cauldron, furs and hides drying.
